targets.authors: Piff P., Stancato D., Cote S., Mendoza-Denton R. & Keltner D.
targets.title: Higher social class predicts increased unethical behavior
targets.evidence_quote: The goal of the current project was to directly replicate Study 7 in Piff et al. 3 and share the four replication datasets 3 .
targets.outcome_quote: Across four independent replications investigating the interaction between greed and unethical behaviour, a near-zero effect size was found. In the current study, the findings did not suggest any significant differences from the null.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The title and stated primary test concern moderation by greed. That interaction failed across all four replications; incidental greed main effects do not change the central verdict.

reasoning: Identity and authors verified in the full article. One published paper targeted, specifically Study 7; all four new-sample replications aggregated.
